## Overview

MarkdStage v4.0.0 is the Windows Store-cutover release. It improves the Windows Desktop
presenter and CLI workflow, including more reliable packaged-app launches, current-workspace
handling, Archify diagram imports, and PowerPoint export diagnostics and recovery. It also adds
Store-ready Windows packaging and desktop skill installation guidance.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is a breaking change for Windows Desktop distribution: the Store package becomes
the supported Windows distribution, and the previous extracted archive receives no further
updates. Existing Markdown workspaces, assets, and themes remain unchanged; install the Store
version, open the same workspace, and remove the old extracted archive folder.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.0.0`. |
| Canvas Extension | Install `.github/extensions/markdstage` from the `v4.0.0` tag. |
| CLI | Update `@markdstage/markdstage` to version `4.0.0`. |
| Desktop | Use the v4.0.0 Windows package for the matching architecture. |
| Microsoft Store | Coming soon; submit the Store package after the GitHub release is published. |
